summary: Crow's nest atop a tree on Kaniksu National Forest, Boundary County; Fisher Peak's history also places a crow's nest here. No source describes the site today.

evidence.supports: Farnham Peak is on Kaniksu National Forest
Farnham Peak is in Idaho (page sits under the IDAHO heading)
Farnham Peak is in Boundary County
Location given as township 63 north, range 1 west, section 5
Listing describes the site as a crow's nest atop a tree
Fisher Peak lookout: 1937 L-4 cab on that peak
Crow's nest two miles southeast of Fisher Peak, at Farnham Peak
evidence.quote: Crow’s nest 2 miles southest at Farnham Peak

evidence.supports: Listing says Farnham Peak carried a crow's nest

notes_for_editor: Only two sources, both brief. The crow's nest has no date in either source; the Fisher Peak history's line sits under its 1964 entry, but the text does not say the crow's nest dates from then, so the story gives no date. The Fisher Peak page spells 'southest' and the quote keeps that spelling. Farnham Peak is not in the Forest Fire Lookout Association's Idaho list and the NHLR Idaho index has no entry. The record's point (48.846, -116.4935) was not checked against a survey; a search snippet from listsofjohn.com gives a summit about half a kilometre away, which may be the summit rather than the crow's nest. Status, access and visit facts are unknown and are not recorded.
